phase_history.notes: Full spec provided by user: dedicated 2004-2010 uplifting/hard trance mid-bass synth. 3 osc + sub, unison w/ mono mode, Roland-style filter w/ feedback saturation, fast envelopes, 2 LFO, 6-slot matrix, saturation/EQ/transient, macros, FX chain, analyzer, keyboard strip.

Reuse audit done (.ideas/vaz-reuse-audit.md): OscBlock/Type-R/ADSR/LFO/ModMatrix/Biquad/FFT/Vaz FX engines all port from verified code. ROADMAP.md phases 0-9. Native JUCE GUI (custom LookAndFeel + MidiKeyboardComponent per spec, like TranceChords). Filter = Type-R (LP) + ZDF SVF (HP/BP).

Phase 1: MbOscillators.h — 3x VAZ OscBlock + sub (true bypass) + 8-voice unison (mono-unison rule) + sync/FM/ring + per-osc drift. 11 new Catch2 cases, all green 10/10 seeds. FM+ring alias fixed via band-limited (mip+1) modulator taps: ring -36 dB -> -89 dB, FM -38 dB -> -51 dB. Pulse waveshape mapping corrected vs TranceAcid (square = waveshape 0.5).

Phase 2: MbFilter.h hybrid filter. Type-R (bit-exact) LP24/LP12 + derived ZDF SVF HP12/BP12 w/ always-on tanh feedback sat (drive-matched). Measured calibration: Type-R corner 1.45x -> pre-scaled; passband +5.0/+2.8 dB gain align. 256-sample equal-power mode crossfade, all 12 ordered pairs click-free (<-60 dBFS HF gate). One cutoff law (modulatedCutoff, +-5 oct env). Slopes: LP24 -23.5, LP12 -12.8, HP12 +13.2 dB/oct; BP12 peak 998.6/1000. THD drive deltas: R 14.9 dB vs SVF 10.9 dB. 8 filter test cases green.

Phase 3: MbVoice.h (stack 1x/2x/4x pre-filter sum, shared stereo MbFilter, ta::AdsrEnv x2, VAZClone constant-rate glide w/ legato-only, retrig/legato modes) + processor wiring: mono note stack w/ held-note fallback, sample-accurate MIDI, pitch bend, first audible path. Env timing 0.2-4% (gate 5%). Retrigger two-gate design: artifact isolation (static cutoff, slow VCA) 0.0015 vs 0.0025 budget; pluck retrigger chirp 1.06x first attack (gate 2x). 36 cases green 3x. Plugin builds clean; pluginval PASSED.

Phase 4: MbMod.h (MbLfo 5 shapes w/ defined retrigger origins + 5ms slew on Square/S&H; exact sync table incl dotted/triplet; ModMatrix6) wired into voice+processor (BPM per block from playhead, CC1/aftertouch, control-rate Drive dest). Evidence: LFO rate exact @44.1k+96k; sync table exact @120/137.4 BPM, BPM change tracked next block; retrig origins verified per shape; superposition linear (5600 Hz exact both SRs) + clamped pins (20 Hz / 0.45sr / reso 0..1 / pitch +-24st); slew tau 4.97/4.98 ms sr-independent; volume-route click gate -60dB PASS; Type-R sweep zipper documented (<-42 dBFS ceiling, VAZ table quantization). 44 cases green 3x; pluginval PASSED.

Phase 5: MbTone.h — 5-type saturator (2x OS via 127-tap Kaiser half-band pair, INTEGER 63-sample round trip, dry delay-aligned, latency reported via setLatencySamples + pluginval PASS), RBJ 3-band EQ (TranceEQ Biquad), transient shaper (bounded 0.25..4). Null test -63.9..-102 dB (gate -60, 3 seeds x 2 SRs); drive-0 bit-exact per type; alias gates per type (Tape/Tube -80, Soft -80, Diode -53.5 after C1 asymmetry fix, Hard -46 w/ 8dB improvement gate documented); THD ranking Soft<Tape<Tube<Diode<Hard w/ h2/h3 family signatures; EQ matches analytic RBJ within 0.35 dB at 44.1k+96k; transient attack ratio 6.8->27; denormal flushes verified. Review notes folded: zipper smooth-sweep deferred note, Drive mod interval enforced 128 samples + test. 53 cases green 3x.

framework_selection.rationale: Spec mandates custom LookAndFeel, fixed one-panel layout, juce::MidiKeyboardComponent, sweet-spot arcs on knobs - native JUCE fits exactly (TranceChords precedent). No canvas/web requirement.
